title: SS27 Men's Trending Trims Report
summary: Studs and stones on denim, embroidered birds and florals, contrast piping, flat pockets and coral-like beading lead SS27 menswear trims.

sections.heading: The evidence
sections.body:
- **Studded denim:** oversized stones on jeans and sweaters, seam outlines in studs and rhinestones, at Dolce & Gabbana, Louis Vuitton, Acne Studios and others<sup>[1]</sup>; Philipp Plein's crystal-encrusted denim takes days of handwork<sup>[2]</sup>.
- **Birds:** doves and cranes, hand-illustrated, embroidered, printed or silhouetted, at Yohji Yamamoto, Wooyoungmi and Shinyakozuka<sup>[1]</sup>.
- **Beading:** coral-like beaded accents at Dolce & Gabbana<sup>[2]</sup>.
- **Piping and contrast collars:** on Dior's sleepwear sets<sup>[3]</sup>.
- **Embroidery and colour gradients on shirts:** Egonlab, Dries Van Noten<sup>[4]</sup>.
- **Flat pockets:** cropped jackets with flat pockets that work as shirts at Prada<sup>[2]</sup>.
- **Punk hardware:** safety pins and chains at DSM Kei Ninomiya<sup>[5]</sup>.

sections.heading: Trims table
sections.body:
| Trim | Application | Status |
|---|---|---|
| Studs and stones | Denim seams, jean pockets | Rising |
| Bird embroidery and prints | Shirts, tees | Emerging |
| Contrast piping | Sets, shirts | Rising |
| Flat patch pockets | Cropped jackets, overshirts | Core |
| Beading | Shirts, evening | Emerging |

products: - Studded jeans, embroidered shirts and tees, piped sets, flat-pocket jackets.
design_implications:
- Stud and stone placement should follow seams for a cleaner look.
- Test bead and stud attachment through washing.
commercial_implications: - Studded denim at premium; piping and embroidery work at mid price.
